Implemented the `encryption` package and integrated streaming encryption across `config`, `fileutil`, and `handler` on the `feat/encryption` branch:

- **`encryption` package** ([encryption.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-bpblt_jw/encryption/encryption.go), [config.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-bpblt_jw/encryption/config.go), [encryption_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-bpblt_jw/encryption/encryption_test.go)):
  - [`NewEncryptor`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-bpblt_jw/encryption/encryption.go#L34-L45) validates 32-byte keys and wraps [`ErrInvalidKey`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-bpblt_jw/encryption/encryption.go#L27) on invalid lengths.
  - [`Encryptor.EncryptWriter`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-bpblt_jw/encryption/encryption.go#L47-L66) implements AES-256-GCM streaming with up to 64KB chunks, a 3-byte header (`0x4F 0x44 0x01`), per-chunk 4-byte big-endian length prefix (`nonce + ciphertext + tag`) with unique 12-byte random nonces, a 4-byte zero sentinel, a 32-byte HMAC-SHA256 trailer over all chunk bytes between header and sentinel, and idempotent `Close()`.
  - [`DecryptReader`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-bpblt_jw/encryption/encryption.go#L164-L176) performs lazy initialization and validates headers, versions, chunk framing, GCM authentication, and trailing HMAC-SHA256 integrity during `Read`.
  - [`Config`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-bpblt_jw/encryption/config.go#L25-L33), [`Config.Validate`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-bpblt_jw/encryption/config.go#L75-L81), and [`LoadKey`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-bpblt_jw/encryption/config.go#L129-L214) support `env`, `file`, `literal`, and `derive` key sources (case-insensitive) with mutual exclusivity validation and key derivation.
- **Job Config** ([job.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-bpblt_jw/config/job.go)):
  - Added `Encryption` field and [`Job.Encrypted`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-bpblt_jw/config/job.go#L132-L134) method, and exported [`Job.Validate`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-bpblt_jw/config/job.go#L113-L130) to run encryption config validation.
